title: Musk says Grok Bot cost more to serve than it earned. Some weekly limits were already gone
friendlyTitle: Elon Musk says Grok Bot cost more to run than it earned. Some weekly limits were already used up
summary: Over the Halloween weekend, some Grok Bot users found their weekly allowance used up, including reports of a jump from about 50% to 100% without overnight use. On 1 November, Elon Musk replied on X that the cost of serving Grok Bot was unsustainably high relative to revenue. TechCrunch reports that he has not said how subscriber limits will work from here.
friendlySummary: Over the Halloween weekend, some Grok Bot users found their weekly allowance already used up. Some said it jumped from about 50% to 100% even though they had not used it overnight. On 1 November, Elon Musk replied on X that serving Grok Bot cost more than it brought in, by enough that the cost could not continue. TechCrunch reports that he has not said how paid limits will work from here.
whyItMatters: If Grok Bot is in a workflow you depend on, check the allowance before you assume last week's pace still fits. A growth claim and a limit cut can arrive in the same week. The reset date on your account is the fact that matters, not the growth quote.
